digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion)
propositions: Local developer gates (rebar review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles instead of direct Anthropic endpoints, using layered config file REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE per-class.
All three local gates must execute end-to-end against Bedrock on real tickets, produce parseable verdicts with structured output validation, and show zero direct-Anthropic calls in the usage log.
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path as demonstrated by nonzero cache_read_tokens in the usage log across all three gate runs, not merely cache writes.
The configuration change must be reversible in one step (unsetting REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE) with model classes defaulting back to Anthropic, and the revert must be documented and executed.
Bedrock's cachePoint TTL default (5 minutes) matches Anthropic's cache_control TTL default, so no observable difference in cache behavior occurs between providers when no explicit TTL is set.

No changes to infra/ directory, src/ behavior changes, or production bot configuration are permitted; changes are restricted to local configuration documentation and the layered config file mechanism.
